explanation_bn: Whole-এর প্রান্তে hollow diamond হলো aggregation: দুর্বল whole–part সম্পর্ক যেখানে part আলাদা থাকতে ও share হতে পারে। Filled diamond composition; hollow triangle generalization; dashed open arrow dependency।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A solid line ending in a hollow triangle (SavingsAccount → Account) represents
stem_bn: Hollow triangle-এ শেষ হওয়া solid line (SavingsAccount → Account) বোঝায়
explanation_en: Generalization ("is-a") is a solid line with a hollow triangle pointing at the superclass. The same triangle on a dashed line is realization (a class implementing an interface).
explanation_bn: Generalization ("is-a") হলো superclass-এর দিকে hollow triangle-সহ solid line। একই triangle dashed line-এ হলে realization (class একটি interface implement করে)।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A class PaymentService implements the interface Payable. In UML this is drawn as
stem_bn: PaymentService class একটি Payable interface implement করে। UML-এ এটি আঁকা হয়
option_a_en: a solid line with a filled diamond
option_b_en: a dashed line with a hollow triangle pointing to Payable
option_b_bn: Payable-এর দিকে hollow triangle-সহ dashed line
option_c_en: a solid line with an open arrowhead
option_d_en: a dashed line with a filled diamond
explanation_en: Realization, the contract between an interface and the class that implements it, is a dashed line with a hollow triangle at the interface end.
explanation_bn: Realization, অর্থাৎ interface ও তা implement করা class-এর চুক্তি, interface-এর প্রান্তে hollow triangle-সহ dashed line।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: An Order class temporarily uses a TaxCalculator passed as a method parameter, without keeping a reference. Which relationship is this?
stem_bn: Order class method parameter হিসেবে পাওয়া TaxCalculator সাময়িকভাবে ব্যবহার করে, কোনো reference রাখে না। এটি কোন relationship?
explanation_en: Dependency is the weakest "uses" relationship: a change in TaxCalculator may affect Order, but Order holds no lasting link. It is drawn as a dashed line with an open arrowhead.
explanation_bn: Dependency সবচেয়ে দুর্বল "uses" সম্পর্ক: TaxCalculator বদলালে Order প্রভাবিত হতে পারে, কিন্তু Order কোনো স্থায়ী link রাখে না। এটি open arrowhead-সহ dashed line।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A Book is made of Chapters; deleting the book deletes its chapters, and a chapter never belongs to two books. Which relationship fits?
stem_bn: একটি Book কয়েকটি Chapter নিয়ে তৈরি; book মুছলে chapter-ও মুছে যায় এবং কোনো chapter দুটি book-এর হয় না। কোন relationship মানানসই?
explanation_en: Exclusive ownership with a shared life cycle is composition, drawn with a filled diamond at the Book end. Aggregation would allow chapters to live on or be shared.
explanation_bn: একচেটিয়া মালিকানা ও একই জীবনচক্র হলো composition, Book প্রান্তে filled diamond। Aggregation হলে chapter আলাদা টিকে থাকত বা share হতে পারত।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: On the association Customer 1 ——— 0..* Order, what does '0..*' at the Order end mean?
stem_bn: Customer 1 ——— 0..* Order association-এ Order প্রান্তের '0..*' মানে কী?
option_a_en: Every order belongs to zero or more customers
option_a_bn: প্রতিটি order শূন্য বা একাধিক customer-এর
option_b_en: A customer may have no orders or many orders
option_b_bn: একজন customer-এর কোনো order না থাকতে পারে বা অনেক থাকতে পারে
option_c_en: A customer must have at least one order
option_c_bn: একজন customer-এর অন্তত একটি order থাকতেই হবে
option_d_en: An order has exactly one line item
option_d_bn: একটি order-এ ঠিক একটি line item
explanation_en: Multiplicity is read at the far end: from one Customer you reach 0..* Orders. The '1' at the Customer end says each Order has exactly one Customer. '1..*' would mean at least one order.
explanation_bn: Multiplicity পড়া হয় উল্টো প্রান্তে: একজন Customer থেকে 0..* Order। Customer প্রান্তের '1' বলে প্রতিটি Order-এর ঠিক একজন Customer। '1..*' হলে অন্তত একটি order লাগত।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A domain model (conceptual class diagram) normally shows
stem_bn: Domain model (conceptual class diagram) সাধারণত দেখায়
option_a_en: conceptual classes, attributes and associations, without operations
option_a_bn: Operation ছাড়া conceptual class, attribute ও association
option_b_en: classes with full method signatures and visibility
option_b_bn: পূর্ণ method signature ও visibility-সহ class
option_d_en: the deployment of software on servers
explanation_en: The domain model visualises real-world concepts in the problem domain. Operations, visibility and types are added later in the design class diagram.
explanation_bn: Domain model সমস্যা-ক্ষেত্রের বাস্তব ধারণা দেখায়। Operation, visibility ও type পরে design class diagram-এ যুক্ত হয়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: CRC in CRC cards stands for
stem_bn: CRC card-এ CRC-এর পূর্ণরূপ
explanation_en: Beck and Cunningham (OOPSLA 1989) proposed index cards holding a class name, its responsibilities and its collaborators to teach and brainstorm object design.
explanation_bn: Beck ও Cunningham (OOPSLA 1989) object design শেখানো ও brainstorm করার জন্য class-এর নাম, responsibility ও collaborator লেখা index card প্রস্তাব করেন।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: In responsibility-driven design, the two kinds of object responsibility are
stem_bn: Responsibility-driven design-এ object-এর দুই ধরনের responsibility হলো
explanation_en: Knowing responsibilities cover the data and related objects an object knows about; doing responsibilities cover the actions it performs or initiates (Larman).
explanation_bn: Knowing responsibility হলো object যে data ও সম্পর্কিত object সম্পর্কে জানে; doing responsibility হলো যে কাজ সে করে বা শুরু করে (Larman)।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Which combination indicates a good modular design?
stem_bn: কোন সমন্বয় ভালো modular design নির্দেশ করে?
explanation_en: Modules should depend little on each other (low coupling) and each should do one well-defined job (high cohesion), so changes stay local and modules can be tested and reused.
explanation_bn: Module-গুলো পরস্পরের ওপর কম নির্ভর করবে (low coupling) এবং প্রতিটি একটি সুনির্দিষ্ট কাজ করবে (high cohesion), ফলে পরিবর্তন স্থানীয় থাকে এবং module test ও reuse করা যায়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Which type of cohesion is considered the best?
stem_bn: কোন ধরনের cohesion সবচেয়ে ভালো ধরা হয়?
explanation_en: In Constantine's scale functional cohesion is best (every element contributes to one task) and coincidental is worst (unrelated elements grouped by chance). Logical and temporal are weak.
explanation_bn: Constantine-এর মাপকাঠিতে functional cohesion সবচেয়ে ভালো (প্রতিটি উপাদান একটি কাজে অবদান রাখে) এবং coincidental সবচেয়ে খারাপ (অসম্পর্কিত উপাদান কাকতালীয়ভাবে একসাথে)। Logical ও temporal দুর্বল।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Module A directly modifies a local variable inside module B. Which coupling is this?
stem_bn: Module A সরাসরি module B-এর ভেতরের একটি local variable বদলায়। এটি কোন coupling?
explanation_en: Content coupling, the worst kind, is when one module reaches into another's internals (data or code). Data coupling (passing only needed parameters) is the best; stamp passes a whole record; control passes a flag that steers the other's logic.
explanation_bn: Content coupling, সবচেয়ে খারাপ, যখন এক module অন্যটির ভেতরের data বা code-এ সরাসরি হাত দেয়। Data coupling (শুধু প্রয়োজনীয় parameter পাঠানো) সবচেয়ে ভালো; stamp পুরো record পাঠায়; control এমন flag পাঠায় যা অন্যটির logic চালায়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: How many design patterns are catalogued in the Gang of Four (GoF) book?
stem_bn: Gang of Four (GoF) বইয়ে কতটি design pattern তালিকাভুক্ত?
explanation_en: Gamma, Helm, Johnson and Vlissides (1994) describe 23 patterns: 5 creational, 7 structural and 11 behavioural.
explanation_bn: Gamma, Helm, Johnson ও Vlissides (1994) 23টি pattern বর্ণনা করেন: 5টি creational, 7টি structural ও 11টি behavioural।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: The Singleton pattern belongs to which GoF category?
stem_bn: Singleton pattern GoF-এর কোন শ্রেণির?
explanation_en: Singleton controls object creation (exactly one instance with a global access point), so it is creational, alongside Factory Method, Abstract Factory, Builder and Prototype.
explanation_bn: Singleton object তৈরি নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে (global access point-সহ ঠিক একটি instance), তাই এটি creational, Factory Method, Abstract Factory, Builder ও Prototype-এর সাথে।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A file system treats a single file and a folder of files the same way when computing size. Which pattern is this?
stem_bn: Size হিসাবের সময় একটি file system একক file ও file-ভর্তি folder-কে একইভাবে দেখে। এটি কোন pattern?
explanation_en: Composite (structural) builds part–whole trees so clients treat leaves and containers uniformly through one Component interface. Adapter converts interfaces, Observer notifies dependents, Strategy swaps algorithms.
explanation_bn: Composite (structural) part–whole tree তৈরি করে যাতে client একটি Component interface দিয়ে leaf ও container-কে একইভাবে দেখে। Adapter interface রূপান্তর করে, Observer নির্ভরশীলদের জানায়, Strategy algorithm বদলায়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A substation monitoring system must update a dashboard and send SMS alerts whenever a reading changes. Which pattern fits best?
stem_bn: একটি substation monitoring system-এ reading বদলালেই dashboard update ও SMS alert পাঠাতে হবে। কোন pattern সবচেয়ে মানানসই?
explanation_en: Observer (behavioural) defines a one-to-many dependency: when the subject changes state, all registered observers are notified automatically, and new observers can be added without changing the subject.
explanation_bn: Observer (behavioural) one-to-many নির্ভরতা তৈরি করে: subject-এর state বদলালে নিবন্ধিত সব observer স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে জানতে পারে, এবং subject না বদলেই নতুন observer যোগ করা যায়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: In the MVC pattern, which component receives the user's request and decides which model operation and view to use?
stem_bn: MVC pattern-এ কোন অংশ user-এর request গ্রহণ করে এবং কোন model operation ও view ব্যবহার হবে তা ঠিক করে?
explanation_en: The controller handles input: it calls the model (data and business rules) and selects the view that renders the result. The view only presents data.
explanation_bn: Controller input সামলায়: এটি model (data ও business rule) call করে এবং ফলাফল দেখানোর view বেছে নেয়। View শুধু data উপস্থাপন করে।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: A method in class Invoice mostly reads and calculates with the fields of class Customer rather than its own. This code smell is
stem_bn: Invoice class-এর একটি method নিজের চেয়ে Customer class-এর field বেশি পড়ে ও হিসাব করে। এই code smell হলো
explanation_en: Feature Envy (Fowler) is a method more interested in another class's data than its own; the usual refactoring is Move Method (or Extract Method then move) into Customer.
explanation_bn: Feature Envy (Fowler) এমন method যা নিজের চেয়ে অন্য class-এর data-তে বেশি আগ্রহী; সাধারণ refactoring হলো Move Method (বা Extract Method করে সরানো) Customer-এ।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Adding a new VAT rate forces small edits in the Invoice, Report, Receipt, Ledger and API classes. This code smell is
stem_bn: নতুন VAT rate যোগ করতে Invoice, Report, Receipt, Ledger ও API class-এ ছোট ছোট edit লাগে। এই code smell হলো
explanation_en: Shotgun Surgery: one change is scattered across many classes. Divergent Change is the opposite: one class is changed for many unrelated reasons. Fix Shotgun Surgery by moving the VAT logic into one class (Move Method/Field).
explanation_bn: Shotgun Surgery: একটি পরিবর্তন অনেক class-এ ছড়ানো। Divergent Change উল্টো: একটি class ভিন্ন ভিন্ন কারণে বদলায়। VAT logic একটি class-এ সরিয়ে (Move Method/Field) Shotgun Surgery ঠিক করা হয়।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Polymorphism in object-oriented design means
stem_bn: Object-oriented design-এ polymorphism মানে
option_a_en: hiding an object's data behind methods
option_b_en: the same message producing different behaviour depending on the receiving object's class
option_b_bn: গ্রহণকারী object-এর class অনুযায়ী একই message-এ ভিন্ন আচরণ
option_c_en: a class inheriting from two parents
option_c_bn: একটি class-এর দুটি parent থেকে inherit করা
option_d_en: creating only one instance of a class
option_d_bn: একটি class-এর শুধু একটি instance তৈরি
explanation_en: With polymorphism, payment.pay() runs CardPayment.pay() or CashPayment.pay() depending on the object's run-time class. Option A is encapsulation; D is the Singleton pattern.
explanation_bn: Polymorphism-এ payment.pay() object-এর run-time class অনুযায়ী CardPayment.pay() বা CashPayment.pay() চালায়। A হলো encapsulation; D হলো Singleton pattern।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Write down the use case diagram for an ATM system. Explain the relationships you used.
stem_bn: একটি ATM system-এর use case diagram লিখুন। ব্যবহৃত relationship-গুলো ব্যাখ্যা করুন।
model_answer_en:
Use case diagram: actors (roles outside the system) linked to use cases (services inside the system boundary) with include, extend and generalization where they apply.

Diagram (text form)
[Customer] ── Check Balance ──┐
[Customer] ── Withdraw Cash ──┤
[Customer] ── Transfer Funds ─┤        ┌──────── ATM System ─────────┐
[Customer] ── Change PIN ─────┤        │ Check Balance, Withdraw Cash,│
[Customer] ── Deposit Cash ───┘        │ Transfer Funds, Change PIN,  │
[Technician] ── Refill Cash / Service ATM│ Deposit Cash, Verify PIN,    │
[Core Banking System] (supporting actor) ── Withdraw Cash, Transfer Funds, Check Balance, Deposit Cash
Withdraw Cash ‑‑<<include>>‑‑> Verify PIN      (also Check Balance, Transfer Funds, Change PIN, Deposit Cash)
Print Receipt ‑‑<<extend>>‑‑> Withdraw Cash    (only if the customer asks)
Transfer Funds ◁── Transfer to Own Account, Transfer to Other Bank (generalization)

Actors
| Actor | Kind | Goal |
|---|---|---|
| Customer | primary | gets cash, balance, transfers |
| Bank Technician | primary | refills cash, services the machine |
| Core Banking System | supporting (external system) | authorises debits, returns balances |

Relationships
- Association (solid line): actor takes part in the use case.
- <<include>>: mandatory reuse. Every transaction always performs Verify PIN, so the dashed arrow goes from each base use case to Verify PIN.
- <<extend>>: optional behaviour at an extension point. Print Receipt adds to Withdraw Cash only when requested; the arrow goes from Print Receipt to Withdraw Cash.
- Generalization (hollow triangle): Transfer to Other Bank is a specialised Transfer Funds and inherits its flow.

A use case diagram shows what the system offers and to whom, not the order of steps; each use case is later written as a fully dressed description (precondition: card inserted; main flow; alternatives such as wrong PIN three times → card retained; postcondition: account debited and cash dispensed).
model_answer_bn:
Use case diagram: actor (system-এর বাইরের role) use case-এর (system boundary-র ভেতরের সেবা) সাথে যুক্ত, প্রয়োজনে include, extend ও generalization-সহ।

Diagram (text আকারে)
[Customer] ── Check Balance ──┐
[Customer] ── Withdraw Cash ──┤
[Customer] ── Transfer Funds ─┤        ┌──────── ATM System ─────────┐
[Customer] ── Change PIN ─────┤        │ Check Balance, Withdraw Cash,│
[Customer] ── Deposit Cash ───┘        │ Transfer Funds, Change PIN,  │
[Technician] ── Refill Cash / Service ATM│ Deposit Cash, Verify PIN,    │
[Core Banking System] (supporting actor) ── Withdraw Cash, Transfer Funds, Check Balance, Deposit Cash
Withdraw Cash ‑‑<<include>>‑‑> Verify PIN      (Check Balance, Transfer Funds, Change PIN, Deposit Cash-ও)
Print Receipt ‑‑<<extend>>‑‑> Withdraw Cash    (customer চাইলে তবেই)
Transfer Funds ◁── Transfer to Own Account, Transfer to Other Bank (generalization)

Actor
| Actor | ধরন | লক্ষ্য |
|---|---|---|
| Customer | primary | নগদ টাকা, balance, transfer |
| Bank Technician | primary | cash refill, machine service |
| Core Banking System | supporting (external system) | debit অনুমোদন, balance ফেরত |

Relationship
- Association (solid line): actor use case-এ অংশ নেয়।
- <<include>>: বাধ্যতামূলক reuse। প্রতিটি transaction সবসময় Verify PIN করে, তাই dashed arrow প্রতিটি base use case থেকে Verify PIN-এর দিকে।
- <<extend>>: extension point-এ ঐচ্ছিক আচরণ। চাইলে তবেই Print Receipt, Withdraw Cash-এ যুক্ত হয়; arrow Print Receipt থেকে Withdraw Cash-এর দিকে।
- Generalization (hollow triangle): Transfer to Other Bank হলো বিশেষায়িত Transfer Funds এবং তার flow inherit করে।

Use case diagram দেখায় system কী সেবা দেয় ও কাকে, step-এর ক্রম নয়; পরে প্রতিটি use case fully dressed বর্ণনায় লেখা হয় (precondition: card ঢোকানো; main flow; alternative যেমন তিনবার ভুল PIN → card আটকে রাখা; postcondition: account debit ও cash প্রদান)।
explanation_en: Marks: boundary, actors outside and use cases inside (4); correct include and extend with arrow directions (3); explanation of each relationship (3). Asked in Combined Bank AP 2018; source: ex-question/bit to exabyte/71_bte-g2-p57-banking-it-q01-03.md.
explanation_bn: নম্বর: boundary, বাইরে actor ও ভেতরে use case (4); arrow-এর দিকসহ সঠিক include ও extend (3); প্রতিটি relationship-এর ব্যাখ্যা (3)। Combined Bank AP 2018-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/bit to exabyte/71_bte-g2-p57-banking-it-q01-03.md।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Write down the relationships used in a use case diagram. Describe any of them.
stem_bn: Use case diagram-এ ব্যবহৃত relationship-গুলো লিখুন। যেকোনো একটি বর্ণনা করুন।
model_answer_en:
| Relationship | Between | Notation | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Association | actor ↔ use case | solid line | the actor takes part in (starts or supports) the use case |
| Include | use case → use case | dashed arrow «include», base → included | the base ALWAYS performs the included behaviour (mandatory reuse) |
| Extend | use case → use case | dashed arrow «extend», extending → base | extra behaviour added only when a condition holds, at an extension point |
| Generalization | actor → actor or use case → use case | solid line, hollow triangle at the parent | the child is a specialised kind of the parent and inherits its associations or flow |

Described: «include». When several use cases share a common step, that step is factored out into its own use case and included. In an online banking system, Transfer Funds and Pay Bill both «include» Authenticate User: every run of either base use case runs authentication, and the base use case is incomplete without it. The arrow starts at the base use case and points to the included one. Benefit: the shared steps are written once and changed in one place.
(Contrast: «extend» — Apply Coupon extends Checkout only if the customer has a coupon; Checkout is complete without it.)
model_answer_bn:
| Relationship | কাদের মধ্যে | Notation | অর্থ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Association | actor ↔ use case | solid line | actor use case-এ অংশ নেয় (শুরু বা সহায়তা করে) |
| Include | use case → use case | dashed arrow «include», base → included | base সবসময় included আচরণ সম্পন্ন করে (বাধ্যতামূলক reuse) |
| Extend | use case → use case | dashed arrow «extend», extending → base | শর্ত পূরণ হলে তবেই extension point-এ বাড়তি আচরণ যুক্ত হয় |
| Generalization | actor → actor বা use case → use case | solid line, parent-এর দিকে hollow triangle | child হলো parent-এর বিশেষায়িত রূপ এবং তার association বা flow inherit করে |

বর্ণনা: «include»। কয়েকটি use case-এ একই step থাকলে সেই step আলাদা use case-এ বের করে include করা হয়। Online banking system-এ Transfer Funds ও Pay Bill দুটোই Authenticate User-কে «include» করে: যেকোনোটি চালালেই authentication চলে, এবং এটি ছাড়া base use case অসম্পূর্ণ। Arrow base use case থেকে শুরু হয়ে included-এর দিকে যায়। সুবিধা: সাধারণ step একবার লেখা হয় এবং এক জায়গায় বদলানো যায়।
(তুলনা: «extend» — customer-এর coupon থাকলে তবেই Apply Coupon, Checkout-কে extend করে; এটি ছাড়াও Checkout সম্পূর্ণ।)
explanation_en: Four relationships with notation (3), one described with a correct example and arrow direction (2). Asked in BUET M.Sc. CSE admission, May 2016; source: ex-question/buet-msc-web/2016-05-cse-scribd-852677045/buet-msc-cse-2016-05.md.
explanation_bn: Notation-সহ চারটি relationship (3), সঠিক উদাহরণ ও arrow-এর দিকসহ একটির বর্ণনা (2)। BUET M.Sc. CSE ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, মে 2016-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/buet-msc-web/2016-05-cse-scribd-852677045/buet-msc-cse-2016-05.md।

stem_en: Draw a class diagram for a library management system.
stem_bn: একটি library management system-এর class diagram আঁকুন।
model_answer_en:
Classes (name | attributes | operations)
- Person (abstract) | -name: String, -phone: String |
- Member ▷ Person | -memberId: String, -maxLoans: int | +borrow(c: BookCopy), +returnCopy(c: BookCopy), +reserve(b: Book)
- Librarian ▷ Person | -staffId: String | +issue(l: Loan), +addBook(b: Book)
- Book | -isbn: String, -title: String, -publisher: String, -year: int |
- Author | -authorId: String, -name: String |
- BookCopy | -barcode: String, -status: CopyStatus {AVAILABLE, ON_LOAN, LOST} | +isAvailable(): boolean
- Loan | -issueDate: Date, -dueDate: Date, -returnDate: Date | +isOverdue(): boolean, +fine(): double
- Reservation | -date: Date, -status: String |
- Fine | -amount: double, -paid: boolean | +pay()

Relationships and multiplicities
| From | To | Kind | Multiplicity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Member, Librarian | Person | generalization (hollow triangle at Person) | — |
| Book | BookCopy | composition (filled diamond at Book) | Book 1 ◆— 1..* BookCopy |
| Book | Author | association | Book * — 1..* Author |
| Member | Loan | association | Member 1 — 0..* Loan |
| Loan | BookCopy | association | Loan * — 1 BookCopy (a copy has at most one open loan) |
| Librarian | Loan | association "issues" | Librarian 1 — 0..* Loan |
| Member | Reservation | association | Member 1 — 0..* Reservation; Reservation * — 1 Book |
| Loan | Fine | composition | Loan 1 ◆— 0..1 Fine |

Person ◁── Member 1 ──── 0..* Loan * ──── 1 BookCopy 1..* ──◆ 1 Book * ──── 1..* Author
Person ◁── Librarian 1 ── issues ── 0..* Loan ◆── 0..1 Fine
Member 1 ── 0..* Reservation * ── 1 Book

Design notes: Book (the title) and BookCopy (the physical copy) are separate classes, because a library holds several copies of one ISBN and loans are of copies; copies cannot exist without their Book record, hence composition. Author is shared by many books, so it is only associated.

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Draw a class diagram representing a book: a book is composed of several parts, which in turn are composed of several chapters; chapters are composed of sections. A book has a publisher, publication date and ISBN; a part has a title and a number; a chapter has a title, a number and an abstract; a section has a title and a number.
stem_bn: একটি বইয়ের class diagram আঁকুন: একটি বই কয়েকটি part নিয়ে গঠিত, প্রতিটি part কয়েকটি chapter নিয়ে; chapter-গুলো section নিয়ে গঠিত। বইয়ের publisher, publication date ও ISBN আছে; part-এর title ও number; chapter-এর title, number ও abstract; section-এর title ও number।
model_answer_en:
"Is composed of" means each part belongs to exactly one whole and cannot exist without it, so every link is composition (filled diamond at the whole end).

┌──────────────────────┐
│ Book                 │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -isbn: String        │
│ -publisher: String   │
│ -publicationDate: Date│
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Part                 │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Chapter              │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
│ -abstract: String    │
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Section              │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
└──────────────────────┘

Reading it: Book 1 ◆— 1..* Part; Part 1 ◆— 1..* Chapter; Chapter 1 ◆— 1..* Section. "Several" is taken as one or more (1..*); the 1 at each whole end says a part, chapter or section belongs to exactly one container. Deleting a Book deletes its parts, chapters and sections.
Refinement (optional): Part, Chapter and Section all have title and number, so they may generalise to an abstract DocumentElement {title, number}; the compositions stay as drawn.
model_answer_bn:
"Is composed of" মানে প্রতিটি part ঠিক একটি whole-এর এবং তা ছাড়া থাকতে পারে না, তাই প্রতিটি link composition (whole-এর প্রান্তে filled diamond)।

┌──────────────────────┐
│ Book                 │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -isbn: String        │
│ -publisher: String   │
│ -publicationDate: Date│
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Part                 │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Chapter              │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
│ -abstract: String    │
└──────────◆───────────┘
           │ 1
           │ 1..*
┌──────────┴───────────┐
│ Section              │
├──────────────────────┤
│ -title: String       │
│ -number: int         │
└──────────────────────┘

পড়ার নিয়ম: Book 1 ◆— 1..* Part; Part 1 ◆— 1..* Chapter; Chapter 1 ◆— 1..* Section। "Several" মানে এক বা একাধিক (1..*); প্রতিটি whole প্রান্তের 1 বলে একটি part, chapter বা section ঠিক একটি container-এর। Book মুছলে তার part, chapter ও section মুছে যায়।
উন্নয়ন (ঐচ্ছিক): Part, Chapter ও Section-এর title ও number আছে, তাই এগুলো একটি abstract DocumentElement {title, number}-এ generalise হতে পারে; composition আগের মতোই থাকে।
explanation_en: Composition (not aggregation) because "composed of" implies exclusive ownership. Marks: four classes with the stated attributes (4), filled diamonds at the whole ends (3), multiplicities (3). explanation_bn: "Composed of" একচেটিয়া মালিকানা বোঝায়, তাই composition (aggregation নয়)। নম্বর: উল্লিখিত attribute-সহ চারটি class (4), whole প্রান্তে filled diamond (3), multiplicity (3)। 3 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2023-এর Combined 5 Bank লিখিত পরীক্ষায় এসেছে (প্রশ্নপত্রে পদের নাম ছাপা নেই); উৎস: ex-question/duranta/1777536660-bank-questions-2020-2026/1777536660.md।

stem_en: Draw a class diagram for an e-commerce website where a customer can view different products and can pay either by card or in cash.
stem_bn: একটি e-commerce website-এর class diagram আঁকুন যেখানে customer বিভিন্ন product দেখতে পারেন এবং card বা নগদে (cash) পরিশোধ করতে পারেন।
model_answer_en:
Classes
- Customer | -customerId, -name, -email, -address | +viewProducts(c: Category), +addToCart(p: Product, qty: int), +placeOrder(): Order
- Category | -name |
- Product | -productId, -name, -price: double, -stock: int | +isInStock(): boolean
- Cart | -createdAt | +add(p, qty), +total(): double
- CartItem | -quantity: int |
- Order | -orderId, -date, -status | +total(): double, +pay(p: Payment)
- OrderLine | -quantity: int, -unitPrice: double | +subtotal(): double
- «abstract» Payment | -amount: double, -paidAt: Date | +pay(): boolean
- CardPayment ▷ Payment | -cardNumberMasked, -gatewayRef | +pay(): boolean
- CashPayment ▷ Payment | -receivedBy, -cashReceiptNo | +pay(): boolean

Relationships
| Link | Kind | Multiplicity |
|---|---|---|
| Customer — Order | association "places" | 1 — 0..* |
| Customer ◆— Cart | composition | 1 — 0..1 |
| Cart ◆— CartItem | composition | 1 — 0..* ; CartItem * — 1 Product |
| Order ◆— OrderLine | composition | 1 — 1..* ; OrderLine * — 1 Product |
| Category — Product | association (aggregation acceptable) | 1 — 0..* |
| Order — Payment | association | 1 — 1 |
| CardPayment, CashPayment → Payment | generalization (hollow triangle at Payment) | — |

Sketch
Customer 1 ── places ── 0..* Order 1 ◆── 1..* OrderLine * ── 1 Product * ── 1 Category
Order 1 ── 1 Payment ◁── CardPayment
                    ◁── CashPayment
Customer 1 ◆── 0..1 Cart 1 ◆── 0..* CartItem * ── 1 Product

Why generalization: Order calls payment.pay() without knowing the kind; card and cash override pay() (polymorphism), and a new method such as mobile financial service payment is added as one more subclass without changing Order (open–closed principle).

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Customer browses the catalog, selects items to buy and goes to checkout. The customer fills in shipping information (address, delivery time). The system presents full pricing information and the customer fills in credit card information. The system authorises the purchase, confirms the sale and sends a confirmation email to the customer. Draw a use case diagram for this system.
stem_bn: Customer catalog দেখেন, কেনার item বাছাই করেন এবং checkout-এ যান। Customer shipping তথ্য (ঠিকানা, ডেলিভারির সময়) দেন। System পূর্ণ মূল্য-তথ্য দেখায় এবং customer credit card তথ্য দেন। System কেনাকাটা অনুমোদন করে, বিক্রয় নিশ্চিত করে এবং customer-কে নিশ্চিতকরণ email পাঠায়। এই system-এর use case diagram আঁকুন।
model_answer_en:
Actors
- Customer (primary, human) — left of the boundary
- Payment / Credit Card Authorisation System (supporting, external) — right
- Email Server (supporting, external) — right

Use cases inside "Online Store" boundary
1. Browse Catalog
2. Select Items (Add to Cart)
3. Checkout (the user-goal use case "Buy a Product")
4. Enter Shipping Information
5. Enter Card Information / Make Payment
6. Authorise Payment
7. Send Confirmation Email

Relationships
- Customer —— Browse Catalog, Select Items, Checkout (associations)
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Enter Shipping Information
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Make Payment
- Make Payment ‑‑«include»‑‑> Authorise Payment —— Payment Authorisation System
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Send Confirmation Email —— Email Server
- (optional) Apply Discount Code ‑‑«extend»‑‑> Checkout [if the customer has a code]

Sketch
                 ┌──────────────── Online Store ────────────────┐
[Customer] ───── │ (Browse Catalog)   (Select Items)            │
         \───── │ (Checkout) ‑‑include‑‑> (Enter Shipping Info) │
                 │     │‑‑include‑‑> (Make Payment) ‑‑include‑‑> (Authorise Payment) │──── [Card Authorisation System]
                 │     └‑‑include‑‑> (Send Confirmation Email) │──── [Email Server]
                 └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Why include: every checkout must collect shipping data, take payment and confirm, so these are mandatory sub-goals. "Presents full pricing" is a step inside Checkout, not a separate use case. Actors are roles: the bank's authorisation service and the mail server are external systems, so they are drawn as actors outside the boundary.
model_answer_bn:

- Payment / Credit Card Authorisation System (supporting, external) — ডানে
- Email Server (supporting, external) — ডানে

"Online Store" boundary-র ভেতরের use case
1. Browse Catalog
2. Select Items (Add to Cart)
3. Checkout (user-goal use case "Buy a Product")
4. Enter Shipping Information
5. Enter Card Information / Make Payment
6. Authorise Payment
7. Send Confirmation Email

Relationship
- Customer —— Browse Catalog, Select Items, Checkout (association)
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Enter Shipping Information
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Make Payment
- Make Payment ‑‑«include»‑‑> Authorise Payment —— Payment Authorisation System
- Checkout ‑‑«include»‑‑> Send Confirmation Email —— Email Server
- (ঐচ্ছিক) Apply Discount Code ‑‑«extend»‑‑> Checkout [customer-এর code থাকলে]

[Customer] ───── │ (Browse Catalog)   (Select Items)            │
         \───── │ (Checkout) ‑‑include‑‑> (Enter Shipping Info) │
                 │     │‑‑include‑‑> (Make Payment) ‑‑include‑‑> (Authorise Payment) │──── [Card Authorisation System]
                 │     └‑‑include‑‑> (Send Confirmation Email) │──── [Email Server]
                 └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘

কেন include: প্রতিটি checkout-এ shipping তথ্য নেওয়া, পরিশোধ ও নিশ্চিতকরণ বাধ্যতামূলক উপ-লক্ষ্য। "পূর্ণ মূল্য দেখানো" Checkout-এর ভেতরের একটি step, আলাদা use case নয়। Actor হলো role: ব্যাংকের authorisation service ও mail server external system, তাই boundary-র বাইরে actor হিসেবে আঁকা।
explanation_en: Marks: three actors with the two external systems outside (3), use cases named as goals (3), correct include arrows (3), no internal steps drawn as actors (1). Asked in Combined Bank Officer(IT) 2024; source: ex-question/duranta/1728262949-officer-it/1728262949.md.
explanation_bn: নম্বর: দুটি external system-সহ তিনটি actor বাইরে (3), লক্ষ্য হিসেবে নামকৃত use case (3), সঠিক include arrow (3), ভেতরের step-কে actor না আঁকা (1)। Combined Bank Officer(IT) 2024-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/duranta/1728262949-officer-it/1728262949.md।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Explain coupling and cohesion with examples. Why should a design aim for low coupling and high cohesion?
stem_bn: উদাহরণসহ coupling ও cohesion ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Design-এ কেন low coupling ও high cohesion লক্ষ্য রাখা উচিত?
model_answer_en:
Definitions (Larry Constantine, structured design)
- Coupling: the degree of interdependence between modules — how much one module must know about, or is affected by, another.
- Cohesion: how strongly the elements inside one module belong together and serve one purpose.

Types of coupling (best → worst)
| Type | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Data | only the needed simple parameters are passed | computeTax(income) |
| Stamp | a whole record is passed, only part is used | printLabel(customerRecord) uses only the address |
| Control | a flag steers the other module's logic | report(data, isSummary) |
| External | modules share an external format, device or protocol | two modules both parse the same bank file layout |
| Common | modules share global data | several modules write a global taxRate |
| Content | one module changes another's internals or jumps into its code | module A edits B's local variable |

Types of cohesion (best → worst)
| Type | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Functional | all parts do one task | calculateNetSalary() |
| Sequential | output of one part feeds the next | read → validate → save a record |
| Communicational | parts work on the same data | print and email the same invoice |
| Procedural | parts follow an order of execution | steps of a startup routine |
| Temporal | parts run at the same time | init(): open files, reset counters, show logo |
| Logical | parts do similar kinds of things, chosen by a flag | doIO(type) for disk, printer, screen |
| Coincidental | parts unrelated | a Utils class with date, tax and email code |

Example of improving a design: a Payroll module reads and writes the global variables of the HR module (common coupling) and also prints reports and sends emails (low cohesion). Refactor: HR exposes getEmployee(id); Payroll only receives the data it needs (data coupling); printing and email move to a Reporting module, so Payroll does only salary calculation (functional cohesion).

Why low coupling + high cohesion
- A change stays inside one module (less ripple effect, cheaper maintenance).
- Modules can be understood, unit-tested and reused independently.
- Teams can work in parallel on separate modules.
- Faults are easier to locate.
model_answer_bn:
সংজ্ঞা (Larry Constantine, structured design)
- Coupling: module-গুলোর পারস্পরিক নির্ভরতার মাত্রা — একটি module-কে অন্যটি সম্পর্কে কতটা জানতে হয় বা তার দ্বারা কতটা প্রভাবিত হয়।
- Cohesion: একটি module-এর ভেতরের উপাদানগুলো কতটা দৃঢ়ভাবে একসাথে একটি উদ্দেশ্য পূরণ করে।

Coupling-এর ধরন (ভালো → খারাপ)
| ধরন | অর্থ | উদাহরণ |
|---|---|---|
| Data | শুধু প্রয়োজনীয় সরল parameter পাঠানো | computeTax(income) |
| Stamp | পুরো record পাঠানো, ব্যবহার হয় অংশমাত্র | printLabel(customerRecord) শুধু ঠিকানা ব্যবহার করে |
| Control | একটি flag অন্য module-এর logic চালায় | report(data, isSummary) |
| External | module-গুলো একটি external format, device বা protocol share করে | দুটি module একই bank file layout parse করে |
| Common | module-গুলো global data share করে | কয়েকটি module একটি global taxRate লেখে |
| Content | এক module অন্যটির ভেতরের অংশ বদলায় বা তার code-এ jump করে | module A, B-এর local variable বদলায় |

Cohesion-এর ধরন (ভালো → খারাপ)
| ধরন | অর্থ | উদাহরণ |
|---|---|---|
| Functional | সব অংশ একটি কাজ করে | calculateNetSalary() |
| Sequential | এক অংশের output পরের অংশের input | read → validate → save a record |
| Communicational | অংশগুলো একই data নিয়ে কাজ করে | একই invoice print ও email |
| Procedural | অংশগুলো execution-এর ক্রম মেনে চলে | startup routine-এর ধাপ |
| Temporal | অংশগুলো একই সময়ে চলে | init(): file খোলা, counter reset, logo দেখানো |
| Logical | flag দিয়ে বাছাই করা একই ধরনের কাজ | disk, printer, screen-এর জন্য doIO(type) |
| Coincidental | অংশগুলো অসম্পর্কিত | date, tax ও email code-সহ একটি Utils class |

Design উন্নয়নের উদাহরণ: একটি Payroll module HR module-এর global variable পড়ে ও লেখে (common coupling) এবং report print ও email-ও পাঠায় (low cohesion)। Refactor: HR, getEmployee(id) দেয়; Payroll শুধু প্রয়োজনীয় data পায় (data coupling); printing ও email একটি Reporting module-এ যায়, ফলে Payroll শুধু বেতন হিসাব করে (functional cohesion)।

কেন low coupling + high cohesion
- পরিবর্তন একটি module-এর ভেতরে থাকে (কম ripple effect, সস্তা maintenance)।
- Module আলাদাভাবে বোঝা, unit-test ও reuse করা যায়।
- Team আলাদা module-এ সমান্তরালে কাজ করতে পারে।
- ত্রুটি খুঁজে পাওয়া সহজ হয়।
explanation_en: Both ranked lists with one example each and a before/after refactoring earn full marks. Asked in BSCL AE(CSE) 2025; source: ex-question/BUET JOB/34_bscll-ae-and-bba-questions.md.
explanation_bn: উদাহরণসহ দুটি ক্রমতালিকা এবং refactoring-এর আগে/পরে দেখালে পূর্ণ নম্বর। BSCL AE(CSE) 2025-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/BUET JOB/34_bscll-ae-and-bba-questions.md।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: What is MVC? Draw the MVC pattern and write its advantages.
stem_bn: MVC কী? MVC pattern আঁকুন এবং এর সুবিধাগুলো লিখুন।
model_answer_en:
MVC (Model–View–Controller) is an architectural pattern, created by Trygve Reenskaug for Smalltalk at Xerox PARC in the late 1970s, that splits an interactive application into three parts:
- Model: the data and business rules (e.g. Account, balance rules, database access). It knows nothing about the screen.
- View: presents model data to the user (HTML page, mobile screen, report). Several views can show one model.
- Controller: receives user input (a click or an HTTP request), calls the model and chooses the view to render.

Diagram
           (1) request / input
   User ───────────────────────▶ Controller
    ▲                              │ (2) update / query
    │ (5) rendered page             ▼
   View ◀──── (4) data for view ── Model ⇄ Database
         ◀────────────(3) controller selects view────────

Flow for a login in a web MVC framework (e.g. Spring MVC, Laravel, Django):
1. GET /login → LoginController.showForm() returns the login View.
2. User submits POST /login with username and password → LoginController.login().
3. Controller calls the Model: UserService.authenticate(u, p) checks the hashed password in the users table.
4. Success → controller stores the session and redirects to the Dashboard view; failure → returns the login View with an error message.

Advantages
- Separation of concerns: UI, input handling and business logic change independently.
- Parallel development: designers work on views while developers write models and controllers.
- Multiple views of the same model (web, mobile app, PDF report).
- Easier unit testing of models and controllers without the UI.
- Reuse and maintainability; supported by most web frameworks.
Limitations: more classes and indirection; for a very small app it adds overhead.
model_answer_bn:
MVC (Model–View–Controller) হলো একটি architectural pattern, ১৯৭০-এর দশকের শেষে Xerox PARC-এ Smalltalk-এর জন্য Trygve Reenskaug তৈরি করেন, যা একটি interactive application-কে তিন ভাগে ভাগ করে:
- Model: data ও business rule (যেমন Account, balance-এর নিয়ম, database access)। এটি screen সম্পর্কে কিছু জানে না।
- View: model-এর data user-কে দেখায় (HTML page, mobile screen, report)। একাধিক view একটি model দেখাতে পারে।
- Controller: user input (click বা HTTP request) নেয়, model call করে এবং কোন view দেখানো হবে তা বেছে নেয়।

Diagram
           (1) request / input
   User ───────────────────────▶ Controller
    ▲                              │ (2) update / query
    │ (5) rendered page             ▼
   View ◀──── (4) data for view ── Model ⇄ Database
         ◀────────────(3) controller selects view────────

Web MVC framework-এ (যেমন Spring MVC, Laravel, Django) login-এর flow:
1. GET /login → LoginController.showForm() login View ফেরত দেয়।
2. User username ও password দিয়ে POST /login পাঠান → LoginController.login()।
3. Controller Model call করে: UserService.authenticate(u, p) users table-এ hashed password মেলায়।
4. সফল হলে → controller session রাখে এবং Dashboard view-এ redirect করে; ব্যর্থ হলে → error message-সহ login View ফেরত দেয়।

সুবিধা
- Separation of concerns: UI, input handling ও business logic আলাদাভাবে বদলানো যায়।
- সমান্তরাল development: designer view-এ, developer model ও controller-এ কাজ করেন।
- একই model-এর একাধিক view (web, mobile app, PDF report)।
- UI ছাড়াই model ও controller-এর সহজ unit testing।
- Reuse ও maintainability; বেশিরভাগ web framework সমর্থন করে।
সীমাবদ্ধতা: বেশি class ও indirection; খুব ছোট app-এ বাড়তি বোঝা।
explanation_en: Asked in WZPGCL AE(CSE) 2023 ("What is MVC? Draw MVC pattern") and BPSC ANE 2020 ("MVC framework কী? এর সুবিধা"); the GET/POST login flow also answers DUET AP 2020 and NESCO AM(ICT) 2021. Sources: ex-question/duranta/1704037243-wzpdcl-ae-cse-ece-ete/1704037243.md, ex-question/ministry-ap-web/2020-bpsc-ane-written-itjobexam/bpsc-ane-2020-written.md.
explanation_bn: WZPGCL AE(CSE) 2023 ("What is MVC? Draw MVC pattern") ও BPSC ANE 2020-এ ("MVC framework কী? এর সুবিধা") এসেছে; GET/POST login flow DUET AP 2020 ও NESCO AM(ICT) 2021-এর প্রশ্নেরও উত্তর দেয়। উৎস: ex-question/duranta/1704037243-wzpdcl-ae-cse-ece-ete/1704037243.md, ex-question/ministry-ap-web/2020-bpsc-ane-written-itjobexam/bpsc-ane-2020-written.md।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Draw a class diagram: a token-ring local area network consists of nodes around which packets are sent. Every node has a unique name within the network and refers to its next node. Workstations originate messages; servers and printers are nodes that can receive messages. Packets contain an originator, a destination and content, and are sent around a network. A LAN is a circular configuration of nodes.
stem_bn: Class diagram আঁকুন: একটি token-ring LAN কয়েকটি node নিয়ে গঠিত যাদের মধ্যে packet ঘোরে। প্রতিটি node-এর network-এ একটি অনন্য নাম আছে এবং সেটি তার পরের node-কে refer করে। Workstation message তৈরি করে; server ও printer হলো message গ্রহণকারী node। Packet-এ originator, destination ও content থাকে এবং network-এ ঘোরানো হয়। LAN হলো node-এর একটি বৃত্তাকার বিন্যাস।
model_answer_en:
Classes
- LAN | -name: String | +send(p: Packet), +addNode(n: Node)
- «abstract» Node | -name: String {unique within LAN} | +accept(p: Packet), +forward(p: Packet)
- Workstation ▷ Node | | +originate(dest: Node, content: String): Packet
- Server ▷ Node | | +receive(p: Packet)
- Printer ▷ Node | | +print(p: Packet)
- Packet | -content: String |

Relationships
| Link | Kind | Multiplicity / note |
|---|---|---|
| LAN ◇— Node | aggregation (composition also accepted) | LAN 1 — 2..* Node; {ordered, circular} |
| Node — Node "nextNode" | reflexive association, navigable to the next | each Node → exactly 1 next Node; 1 previous |
| Workstation, Server, Printer → Node | generalization (hollow triangle at Node) | — |
| Packet — Workstation "originator" | association | Packet * — 1 Workstation |
| Packet — Node "destination" | association | Packet * — 1 Node (server or printer) |
| LAN — Packet "circulates on" | association | LAN 1 — 0..* Packet |

Sketch
           ┌─────────────── nextNode 1 ───────────────┐
LAN 1 ◇── 2..* «abstract» Node ◀──────────────────────┘
                    △
      ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
 Workstation      Server         Printer
      │ 1 originator                │
Packet * ──── destination 1 ──▶ Node
(content)

Notes: the circular ring is modelled by the self-association nextNode (multiplicity 1) together with the constraint {circular} on LAN; "unique name within the network" is a constraint {unique} on Node.name, not a separate class. Only Workstation may originate, so the originator end points to Workstation, while the destination end points to the general Node.
model_answer_bn:
Class
- LAN | -name: String | +send(p: Packet), +addNode(n: Node)
- «abstract» Node | -name: String {LAN-এর মধ্যে unique} | +accept(p: Packet), +forward(p: Packet)
- Workstation ▷ Node | | +originate(dest: Node, content: String): Packet
- Server ▷ Node | | +receive(p: Packet)
- Printer ▷ Node | | +print(p: Packet)
- Packet | -content: String |

Relationship
| Link | ধরন | Multiplicity / নোট |
|---|---|---|
| LAN ◇— Node | aggregation (composition-ও গ্রহণযোগ্য) | LAN 1 — 2..* Node; {ordered, circular} |
| Node — Node "nextNode" | reflexive association, পরের node-এর দিকে navigable | প্রতিটি Node → ঠিক 1টি পরের Node; 1টি আগের |
| Workstation, Server, Printer → Node | generalization (Node-এ hollow triangle) | — |
| Packet — Workstation "originator" | association | Packet * — 1 Workstation |
| Packet — Node "destination" | association | Packet * — 1 Node (server বা printer) |
| LAN — Packet "circulates on" | association | LAN 1 — 0..* Packet |

Sketch
           ┌─────────────── nextNode 1 ───────────────┐
LAN 1 ◇── 2..* «abstract» Node ◀──────────────────────┘
                    △
      ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
 Workstation      Server         Printer
      │ 1 originator                │
Packet * ──── destination 1 ──▶ Node
(content)

নোট: বৃত্তাকার ring model করা হয় self-association nextNode (multiplicity 1) এবং LAN-এর {circular} constraint দিয়ে; "network-এ অনন্য নাম" হলো Node.name-এর {unique} constraint, আলাদা class নয়। শুধু Workstation originate করতে পারে, তাই originator প্রান্ত Workstation-এর দিকে, আর destination প্রান্ত সাধারণ Node-এর দিকে।
explanation_en: The marks are in the reflexive nextNode association, the Node generalization hierarchy and the two distinct Packet associations. Asked in BB AP 2023; source: ex-question/duranta/1737452307-bangladesh-bank-ad-ict-question-pattern-bb-assistant-program/1737452307.md.
explanation_bn: নম্বর আছে reflexive nextNode association, Node-এর generalization hierarchy এবং Packet-এর দুটি আলাদা association-এ। BB AP 2023-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/duranta/1737452307-bangladesh-bank-ad-ict-question-pattern-bb-assistant-program/1737452307.md।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Compare the waterfall requirements phase with the Inception phase of the Unified Process. A Bangladeshi city corporation wants an online holding-tax payment system but is unsure of the scope; which approach would you advise and why?
stem_bn: Waterfall-এর requirements phase-এর সাথে Unified Process-এর Inception phase-এর তুলনা করুন। বাংলাদেশের একটি সিটি করপোরেশন online holding-tax পরিশোধ system চায় কিন্তু scope নিয়ে নিশ্চিত নয়; কোন পদ্ধতির পরামর্শ দেবেন এবং কেন?
model_answer_en:
| Aspect | Waterfall requirements phase | UP Inception |
|---|---|---|
| Goal | specify all requirements completely before design | decide whether the project is worth doing; frame its scope |
| Depth | full and detailed, then frozen | high-level; about 10% of use cases detailed |
| Main output | signed-off SRS | vision, business case, initial use-case model, risk list, rough estimate |
| Duration | long, one pass | short (days to a few weeks), may be one iteration |
| Change | through formal change control, costly | expected; requirements keep growing in Elaboration |
| Risk | not a first-class output | initial risk list is a key deliverable |
| Next step | design starts only after sign-off | Elaboration builds and tests the architecture in iterations |

Advice for the holding-tax system: follow UP-style iterative development starting with Inception.
- Inception (2–3 weeks): identify stakeholders (citizens, tax officers, bank/MFS payment gateways, the IT cell), write the vision and business case, list the main use cases (Search Holding, View Assessment, Pay Tax, Download Receipt, Officer Reconciliation), record risks (gateway integration, data quality of old assessments, legal rules) and give a rough cost range — then a go/no-go decision.
- Elaboration: detail the risky use cases (Pay Tax, reconciliation) and build an architecture baseline with one working payment path.
- Construction and Transition: add features in iterations and pilot in one ward before city-wide rollout.
Reason: the scope is uncertain and the users must see working screens to clarify needs; a waterfall SRS frozen now would contain wrong requirements discovered only during testing, when fixing them is far costlier. Waterfall would suit only if the rules and screens were already fixed by a detailed ToR.
model_answer_bn:
| বিষয় | Waterfall requirements phase | UP Inception |
|---|---|---|
| লক্ষ্য | design-এর আগে সব requirement সম্পূর্ণভাবে নির্দিষ্ট করা | project করা উচিত কি না ঠিক করা; scope-এর কাঠামো দেওয়া |
| গভীরতা | পূর্ণ ও বিস্তারিত, তারপর freeze | high-level; প্রায় 10% use case বিস্তারিত |
| প্রধান output | sign-off করা SRS | vision, business case, initial use-case model, risk list, rough estimate |
| সময়কাল | দীর্ঘ, একবারে | সংক্ষিপ্ত (কয়েক দিন থেকে কয়েক সপ্তাহ), এক iteration হতে পারে |
| পরিবর্তন | formal change control-এর মাধ্যমে, ব্যয়বহুল | প্রত্যাশিত; Elaboration-এ requirement বাড়তে থাকে |
| Risk | প্রধান output নয় | initial risk list একটি মূল deliverable |
| পরের ধাপ | sign-off-এর পরেই design শুরু | Elaboration iteration-এ architecture তৈরি ও পরীক্ষা করে |

Holding-tax system-এর জন্য পরামর্শ: Inception দিয়ে শুরু করে UP-ধাঁচের iterative development।
- Inception (2–3 সপ্তাহ): stakeholder চিহ্নিত করা (নাগরিক, tax officer, ব্যাংক/MFS payment gateway, IT cell), vision ও business case লেখা, প্রধান use case তালিকা (Search Holding, View Assessment, Pay Tax, Download Receipt, Officer Reconciliation), risk লিপিবদ্ধ করা (gateway integration, পুরোনো assessment-এর data quality, আইনি নিয়ম) এবং মোটামুটি খরচের পরিসর দেওয়া — তারপর go/no-go সিদ্ধান্ত।
- Elaboration: ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ use case (Pay Tax, reconciliation) বিস্তারিত করা এবং একটি চলমান payment path-সহ architecture baseline তৈরি।
- Construction ও Transition: iteration-এ feature যোগ এবং পুরো শহরে চালুর আগে এক ward-এ pilot।
কারণ: scope অনিশ্চিত এবং প্রয়োজন স্পষ্ট করতে user-দের চলমান screen দেখা দরকার; এখন freeze করা waterfall SRS-এ ভুল requirement থাকবে যা testing-এ গিয়ে ধরা পড়বে, তখন ঠিক করা অনেক ব্যয়বহুল। শুধু বিস্তারিত ToR-এ নিয়ম ও screen আগেই ঠিক থাকলে waterfall মানানসই হতো।

topic: Waterfall, Inception, Use Cases, UML & OO Design
stem_en: Estimate the size of an e-tender portal at inception using Use Case Points. It has 2 simple actors (external systems with an API), 1 average actor and 2 complex actors (humans using a GUI); 3 simple, 4 average and 1 complex use case; technical factor total TF = 30 and environmental factor total EF = 15. Find UAW, UUCW, TCF, ECF, UCP, and the effort at 20 person-hours per UCP. How many person-months is that at 160 hours per month?
stem_bn: Use Case Points দিয়ে inception-এ একটি e-tender portal-এর আকার estimate করুন। এতে 2টি simple actor (API-যুক্ত external system), 1টি average actor ও 2টি complex actor (GUI ব্যবহারকারী মানুষ); 3টি simple, 4টি average ও 1টি complex use case; technical factor-এর মোট TF = 30 এবং environmental factor-এর মোট EF = 15। UAW, UUCW, TCF, ECF, UCP এবং প্রতি UCP 20 person-hour ধরে effort বের করুন। মাসে 160 ঘণ্টা ধরলে তা কত person-month?
model_answer_en:
Use Case Points (Karner, 1993): UCP = (UUCW + UAW) × TCF × ECF.

Weights
| Item | Simple | Average | Complex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Actor | 1 (system with API) | 2 (system via protocol / text UI) | 3 (human via GUI) |
| Use case | 5 (1–3 transactions) | 10 (4–7) | 15 (8 or more) |

UAW = 2×1 + 1×2 + 2×3 = 2 + 2 + 6 = 10
UUCW = 3×5 + 4×10 + 1×15 = 15 + 40 + 15 = 70
UUCP = UUCW + UAW = 80
TCF = 0.6 + 0.01 × TF = 0.6 + 0.30 = 0.90
ECF = 1.4 − 0.03 × EF = 1.4 − 0.45 = 0.95
UCP = 80 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 68.4
Effort = 68.4 × 20 = 1,368 person-hours
Person-months = 1,368 / 160 = 8.55 ≈ 8.6 person-months

Interpretation: at inception this is only an order-of-magnitude figure (a range of roughly ±30% is normal); it is refined after Elaboration when the use cases are detailed. Karner's 20 hours per UCP is a starting productivity; organisations calibrate it (values around 20–28 are common).
model_answer_bn:
Use Case Points (Karner, 1993): UCP = (UUCW + UAW) × TCF × ECF।

Weight
| Item | Simple | Average | Complex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Actor | 1 (API-যুক্ত system) | 2 (protocol / text UI-এর মাধ্যমে system) | 3 (GUI ব্যবহারকারী মানুষ) |
| Use case | 5 (1–3 transaction) | 10 (4–7) | 15 (8 বা বেশি) |

UAW = 2×1 + 1×2 + 2×3 = 2 + 2 + 6 = 10
UUCW = 3×5 + 4×10 + 1×15 = 15 + 40 + 15 = 70
UUCP = UUCW + UAW = 80
TCF = 0.6 + 0.01 × TF = 0.6 + 0.30 = 0.90
ECF = 1.4 − 0.03 × EF = 1.4 − 0.45 = 0.95
UCP = 80 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 68.4
Effort = 68.4 × 20 = 1,368 person-hour
Person-month = 1,368 / 160 = 8.55 ≈ 8.6 person-month

ব্যাখ্যা: inception-এ এটি শুধু মোটামুটি মাত্রার হিসাব (প্রায় ±30% পরিসর স্বাভাবিক); Elaboration-এ use case বিস্তারিত হলে এটি সংশোধিত হয়। Karner-এর প্রতি UCP 20 ঘণ্টা একটি প্রারম্ভিক productivity; প্রতিষ্ঠান এটি calibrate করে (20–28-এর কাছাকাছি মান প্রচলিত)।
explanation_en: Recomputed with a script: UAW 10, UUCW 70, TCF 0.90, ECF 0.95, UCP 68.4, 1,368 person-hours, 8.55 person-months. Weights from Karner's method as given on en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Use_Case_Points.
explanation_bn: Script দিয়ে পুনরায় হিসাব: UAW 10, UUCW 70, TCF 0.90, ECF 0.95, UCP 68.4, 1,368 person-hour, 8.55 person-month। Weight Karner-এর পদ্ধতি থেকে, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Use_Case_Points অনুযায়ী।

stem_en: In an assignment submission system, a student cannot deny having edited a submission after the deadline. Which software security requirement does this signify?
stem_bn: একটি assignment submission system-এ একজন ছাত্র deadline-এর পরে submission edit করার কথা অস্বীকার করতে পারে না। এটি কোন software security requirement নির্দেশ করে?
explanation_en: Non-repudiation means a party cannot later deny an action it performed, usually enforced with authenticated, time-stamped audit logs or digital signatures. Integrity is about data not being altered without authorisation; confidentiality about who may read; authorisation about what a user may do. No official key was published; this is the standard definition. Asked in BUET M.Sc. CSE admission, April 2021; source: ex-question/buet-msc-web/2021-06-cse-online-mcq-itjobexam/buet-msc-cse-2021-06.md.
explanation_bn: Non-repudiation মানে কোনো পক্ষ পরে নিজের করা কাজ অস্বীকার করতে পারে না, সাধারণত authenticated, time-stamped audit log বা digital signature দিয়ে নিশ্চিত করা হয়। Integrity হলো অনুমতি ছাড়া data না বদলানো; confidentiality কে পড়তে পারবে; authorisation user কী করতে পারবে। কোনো official key প্রকাশিত হয়নি; এটি প্রচলিত সংজ্ঞা। BUET M.Sc. CSE ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, এপ্রিল 2021-এ এসেছে; উৎস: ex-question/buet-msc-web/2021-06-cse-online-mcq-itjobexam/buet-msc-cse-2021-06.md।

stem_en: Which of the following is a non-functional requirement of a mobile banking app?
stem_bn: একটি mobile banking app-এর non-functional requirement কোনটি?

option_a_bn: User অন্য account-এ টাকা পাঠাতে পারেন
option_b_en: The app shows the last ten transactions

stem_en: Which requirement statement is NOT verifiable as written?
